sources.title: GPT-5.6 Terra API model
sources.evidence: Exact undated model ID and default snapshot; 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens. Text/image input, text output, reasoning efforts none through max with medium default, function calling, Responses/Chat Completions/Batch and prompt caching are documented. No immutable dated snapshot is listed.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 launch, July 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Names Sol, Terra and Luna as tiers in the GPT-5.6 generation and explicitly makes Terra available in Work, Codex and the API starting July 9. Benchmark and price comparisons do not disclose parameter counts.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: July 9 entry explicitly releases gpt-5.6-terra alongside Sol and Luna. July 30 reduces Terra pricing; August 5 expands Fast mode to long-context requests. The gpt-5.6 alias routes to Sol, not Terra.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: July 9 card identifies Terra, describes data and reinforcement learning in section 2, exact Terra chain-of-thought controllability in section 8.1.2, and separately trained activation classifiers for Sol and Terra in section 9.4.3.1. These are training, safety and performance details, not a production topology or parameter inventory. Section 9.4.9 describes protecting model weights.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: Later card includes exact gpt-5.6-terra columns, including Table 22 safety comparisons and health/biology tables. Those numbers are evaluation scores, not parameter counts. No exact Terra production parameter count or structural architecture disclosure was found in this card.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 inference efficiency, July 29, 2026
sources.evidence: Discusses optimizing inference, model subnetworks, KV caching and a separate speculative draft model. It does not label the production GPT-5.6 Terra architecture as Transformer or MoE, and the speculative draft architecture is not a specification for Terra.

sources.title: Prompt caching guide
sources.evidence: Describes reusable KV states and GPT-5.6-and-later caching behavior. It supplies no explicit full production Transformer, dense or MoE classification for Terra.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: The archived recipe explains Transformer KV caching but explicitly restricts its applicability to models before GPT-5.6; that architecture explanation is not transferred to Terra.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses accepts PDFs; vision-capable models receive extracted text and page images. Chat Completions supports PDF file inputs. This establishes an API file format when combined with exact Terra vision/endpoint support, not a separate native PDF modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service access while retaining service IP rights. Together with hosted Terra availability and model-weight security, this supports a proprietary service classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 Preview System Card, June 26, 2026
sources.evidence: Describes an earlier limited preview for a small group of trusted partners and plans for general availability in coming weeks. The July 9 date is the subsequent public product/API release, not this restricted preview.

sources.title: OpenAI EU AI Act resources
sources.evidence: The public training-summary list includes GPT-5.6 Luna but no exact Terra summary. Luna training-data quantities or specifications are not transferred to Terra.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: No exact gpt-5.6-terra shutdown entry was found in the current page; Terra appears as a recommended replacement for older models. This is documentation review, not an operational endpoint test.

family.note: The numerical designation identifies the generation; Terra is the tier. Correct the cross-generation gpt-terra grouping.

release_date.note: Retain explicit public product/API release. June 26 was a restricted trusted-partner preview; July 30 pricing and August 5 serving changes are not initial releases.

open_weights.note: Distributed as hosted product/API access; original card describes protecting proprietary model weights. No public weight distribution is identified.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification, not an SPDX identifier or a claim of downloadable weight-license terms.

parameters_b.note: Original Terra training/safety sections, later exact Terra comparison columns and inference engineering disclose no total parameter count. Performance, price and activation-classifier details do not establish size; sibling Luna training summaries do not apply.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active production parameter count found in the reviewed original/later exact-model evidence. Do not equate active and total counts or infer routing from subnetworks.

architecture.note: Exact Terra internal activations, reasoning training and current KV caching are documented, but the reviewed sources do not explicitly establish a structural production classification. The older Transformer caching recipe excludes this generation; speculative draft architecture and serving subnetworks are not evidence of Terra MoE. Bounded exact-name architecture/interpretability/training searches located no stronger primary disclosure.

context_window.note: Current exact API documentation states 1,050,000 context, with explicit 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 output. Applies to the listed undated identifier; no immutable dated snapshot or product UI context limit is inferred.

modalities.note: Retain text/image input and text output, with PDF as supported API file input converted to text/page images. Hosted image-generation tooling is not native image output; audio/video endpoints are unsupported.

reasoning.note: Exact API supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max. Original card independently evaluates Terra chain-of-thought. No public ultra API effort is inferred from product configuration.

tool_call.note: Exact page lists function calling and Responses tools, including search, code interpreter, hosted shell, apply patch, skills, computer use, MCP and tool search.

description.value: GPT-5.6 Terra is an OpenAI model with text and image input, text output, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Replace broad capability/cost marketing with the documented inputs, output and controls.

patch.description: GPT-5.6 Terra is an OpenAI model with text and image input, text output, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.

sources.label: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra

patch.notes: Public product/API release was July 9, 2026, after a limited trusted-partner preview on June 26. The current API page lists only the undated gpt-5.6-terra identifier, with 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens. Reasoning defaults to medium and supports none through max. PDF is an API file-input format converted to text and page images. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the reviewed original and later exact-model sources; production architecture is unverified. KV caching, internal activation classifiers and speculative draft-model engineering do not establish a complete Transformer or MoE architecture for Terra. No exact API shutdown notice was found; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Correct family to gpt-5.6 and proprietary classification; replace promotional description. Confirm July 9 public release, 1.05M context, reasoning, tools and API PDF support. Record June 26 restricted preview and undated identifier. Original and later exact Terra sources do not disclose total/active counts; architecture remains unverified rather than borrowing pre-GPT-5.6 caching explanations.
